findings.topic: Scope coverage does not match work breakdown
findings.expected: Each independent executor declares its packet before producing native items.
findings.actual: Only five scope.set events, all by one root executor; no child scopes. N00–N07 implementation interval4006–8958 has no assigned native items.
findings.why: Work was implemented/delegated without per-executor declaration. Observer correctly retains unassigned source items and does not guess target from prose.
findings.impact: Empty chats and no observed actor per most completed nodes; per-packet execution trace cannot be reconstructed faithfully from existing scope data.
findings.small_fix: Declare current scope before future work and clear after handoff; every child uses its own binding. Preserve existing unassigned items, no retrospective guessed relinking.

findings.expected: Scope follows the current work, including follow-up audits.
findings.actual: After N08 done10400, 29 first-seen projected items stilltarget N08 before scope11180; after completion result11815, subsequent rootitems keep targetingN03. Semantic correctness of each source text was not inferred.
findings.why: No scope reset on completion; done status does not close executor scope by design.
findings.impact: Block streams include later work under the last declaration; this is authentic declared attribution but not independent proof that all contents implement that block.
findings.small_fix: Explicitly clear/redeclare scope at handoff. Add a UI warning that done+active scope is a declaration needing review; do not automatically reassign history.

findings.expected: Before done, packet criteria have concrete per-ID receipts at the actually demonstrated level.
findings.actual: All47 N00–N08 test.result events registered only11508–11554, after done4006–10400; three acceptance gaps found later and new regression proof added. N02 history-warning rendering and two N04 scenarios were incomplete at first closure.
findings.why: Earlier integration wrote node.result/status referencing broad reports without registering individual checks, and broad suite evidence was overextended to three criteria.
findings.impact: Initial all-done view overstated demonstrated acceptance; later47 registrations improve current mapping but cannot make original closure timely.
findings.small_fix: Keep retrospective labels and actual registration time; require per-ID evidence coverage before future completion. Describe late repairs as late repairs, not historical passes.

findings.topic: Current N07 artifact no longer matches immutable receipt pin
findings.expected: A reviewed output receipt names immutable evidence bytes or is superseded after artifact revision.
findings.actual: N07 dependency8929 and result8930 pin an older SHA256 of next-stage/evidence/N07-roadmap.json; currentbytes differ and no replacement sameedge receipt exists. Historical N05 pin8770 also differs but was explicitly replaced10153.
findings.why: Evidence file reused by later validation; dependency resolver evaluates declared evidence/fingerprint and does not read arbitrary filesystem paths.
findings.impact: Current satisfied prerequisite is based on a receipt whose referenced file is mutable; available means declared availability, not current-byteverification.
findings.small_fix: Preserve immutable versioned proof artifacts and add a new authenticated receipt for reviewed current N07 output; retain old receipt and original bytes if recoverable.

findings.topic: Test current label is not automatic source freshness
findings.expected: Readers can distinguish historical pass from fresh validation of current implementation.
findings.actual: 24 C/R00 testresults retain writer-supplied freshness=current and oldplanv55. Stage2source changed; Store selects latest receipt by seq and does not recompute ordinary test freshness. No plan criterion texts changed across six versions.
findings.why: test.result freshness is declared metadata; algorithms have exact implementation revisions, ordinary tests do not.
findings.impact: Historical valid passes may look like full current-code validation. This does not invalidate original runs or justify rerunning everything.
findings.small_fix: Show run/capture basis and historical scope; compare relevant code/input revision when supplied. Use targeted reruns only for changed mechanisms.

findings.topic: Original source delivery evidence paths were reused
findings.expected: Original C01–C04 delivery report continues to reference the original23-check browser receipt and original screenshots.
findings.actual: RESULTS.md and originalmanifest unchanged, but browser-results.json now holds41 C06 realHTTP synthetic checks; three ui screenshots also differ from original hashes. Original36-test XML remains intact and local62-test XML is separate.

findings.topic: One dependency incident generates23 warning records

findings.actual: dependency_starts contains23 records all N08 seq9995–10149, all for missing WPT-NEXT-E-12 and the same missing receipt9992; confirmation10153 later resolves current prerequisite.

findings.small_fix: Group display by scope/requirement unresolved interval or stable incident identity while retaining raw event history.

findings.topic: Early stage dependency workflow cannot be proven retrospectively
findings.expected: Per-stage prerequisite availability and executor starts can be compared in chronological order.
findings.actual: First dependency.observation is8752; N00done4006 and N01/N03/N06firstdone6613/6615/6617 occurred earlier. Most implementation packets have no observedscope/activitytarget. Only laterN08missingalgorithm incident9992–10153 has both availability and attributedactivityhistory.
findings.why: Evidence availability was batch-registered later, with no earlier per-executor scopes. Current satisfied dependency view does not reconstruct historical physical availability.
findings.impact: Cannot assert earlier packet starts respected dependency availability from ledger alone, nor conclude inputs were physically missing. The original unrecorded incident remains unreconstructed; synthetic regressions demonstrate general behavior only.
findings.small_fix: Record actual availability when reviewed and declare scopes before futurestarts. Keep missing historical context explicit rather than infer it from presentdone/satisfied statuses.
